summary.text: Ryan Kelly, an educator and former federal civil servant who ran on the "Affordability, Accountability, People Party" ballot line, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New Jersey's 3rd Congressional District to Herb Conaway.
By his own account his background spans public service, education and civil rights, including work at the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

paragraphs.text: Kelly attended Woodland Park High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University in 2005, and received a graduate degree from Monmouth University in 2007.
WHYY describes him as an educator and a former federal civil servant who spent 13 years with the Department of Homeland Security in government operations and program administration.
He was previously a member of the Lake Como Borough Council in Monmouth County, according to WHYY.
During the campaign, he described his campaign as focused on affordability, accountability and practical governance.
He received 1.3% of the vote to Herb Conaway's 62.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
